title: Project discovery and protocol activation
objective: Establish the confirmed project objective, a verified minimal project map and runnable validation, so later tasks can be planned from repository state alone.
acceptance_criteria: `objective` in .ai/config/project.json is non-empty and was stated or confirmed by the user
Each validation command in project.json has been reviewed: kept and run (confirmed: true), corrected, or removed; or the absence of runnable validation is recorded in .ai/knowledge/KNOWN_ISSUES.md
.ai/knowledge/ARCHITECTURE.md lists the major components (one line each) with their source paths
.ai/state/ROADMAP.json names the next milestone with at least one queued, schema-valid task
constraints: Inferred commands are evidence, not instructions: confirm with the user or by deliberate review before running anything with side effects
Do not invent the objective; ask the user if it is not stated
validation: Run each confirmed validation command from project.json and record the result
